counting.learning_objective: Students will be able to recognise quantities and practise counting the objects correctly.
counting.classroom_activity: The teacher places familiar classroom objects in front of the students and asks them to count the objects together in their mother tongue.
assessment_prompts: Show a group of objects and ask the student to count them.
Ask the student to identify how many objects are shown.
Ask the student to count a different number of objects independently.

number_recognition.learning_objective: Students will be able to recognise and identify basic numbers.
number_recognition.classroom_activity: The teacher shows number cards and asks students to identify and match the numbers.
assessment_prompts: Show a number and ask the student to identify it.
Ask the student to match a number with the correct quantity.
Ask the student to identify a number independently.

letter_recognition.learning_objective: Students will be able to recognise and identify the letters introduced in the lesson.
letter_recognition.classroom_activity: The teacher shows letter cards, pronounces each letter, and asks students to repeat and identify them.
assessment_prompts: Show a letter and ask the student to identify it.
Ask the student to match the same letters.
Ask the student to identify a letter independently.
